name: INcufi
fix_description: In swapCommision, add proper price conversion between CommissionContractToken and contractToken instead of 1:1 exchange. The swap rate should reflect the actual market value of both tokens.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is multi-step and protocol-specific: it abuses the referral/registration and staking-withdraw flow using CREATE2-predicted helper contracts, repeated stake/withdraw cycles, and commission token collection before swapping out value. While there is no flash loan or deep cross-protocol interaction, understanding why the referral chain and repeated withdrawals mint extractable rewards requires more than spotting a simple bug.
